GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FBlackBelt1Text:
Hey, kid! You're
holding us up!

Our policy is to
work behind the

scenes where no
one can see us!
GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FBlackBelt2Text:
I lose my passion
for work if some- one's watching.

Come on, kid,
scoot!
GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FBlackBelt3Text:
Oohah! Oohah!

The stuff on the
ground's junk.

Take it if you
want it!
